sentences.en: I'm used to thinking of the TED audience as a wonderful collection of some of the most effective, intelligent, intellectual, savvy, worldly and innovative people in the world.
sentences.zh: 我习惯于把TED的观众 看作是世界上 最有效力的 聪明的 聪明的 狡猾的

sentences.en: And I think that's true. However, I also have reason to believe that many, if not most, of you are actually tying your shoes incorrectly.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是真的。不过,我有理由相信,你们当中许多人,如果不是大多数,实际上系错鞋带了。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Now I know that seems ludicrous.
sentences.zh: (笑)现在我知道这似乎可笑。

sentences.en: I know that seems ludicrous. And believe me, I lived the same sad life until about three years ago.
sentences.zh: 相信我,我一直过着同样悲惨的生活 直到三年前

sentences.en: And what happened to me was I bought, what was for me, a very expensive pair of shoes.
sentences.zh: 结果我买了一双很贵的鞋

sentences.en: But those shoes came with round nylon laces, and I couldn't keep them tied.
sentences.zh: 但是那些鞋是带着尼龙的鞋带来的 我不能把它们绑在一起

sentences.en: So I went back to the store and said to the owner, "I love the shoes, but I hate the laces."
sentences.zh: 于是我回到商店,对店主说:“我喜欢鞋子,但我讨厌鞋带。”

sentences.en: He took a look and said, "Oh, you're tying them wrong."
sentences.zh: 他看了一眼就说:"哦,你绑错人了"

sentences.en: Now up until that moment, I would have thought that, by age 50, one of the life skills that I had really nailed was tying my shoes.
sentences.zh: 现在直到那一刻,我本以为,到50岁时, 我真正掌握的生活技能之一就是绑住我的鞋子。

sentences.en: (Laughter) But not so -- let me demonstrate.
sentences.zh: (笑声) 但不是这样-- 让我示范一下。

sentences.en: This is the way that most of us were taught to tie our shoes.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们大多数人 学会绑鞋带的方式。

sentences.en: Now as it turns out -- thank you. (Applause) Wait, there's more.
sentences.zh: 现在,事实证明--谢谢。 (掌声)等等,还有更多。

sentences.en: As it turns out -- (Laughter) there's a strong form and a weak form of this knot, and we were taught the weak form.
sentences.zh: 事实证明——(笑声)这个结有很强的形式和微弱的形式, 我们学到了弱的形式。

sentences.en: And here's how to tell. If you pull the strands at the base of the knot, you will see that the bow will orient itself down the long axis of the shoe.
sentences.zh: 这就是如何说明。如果你把绳子拉到绳子的底部, 你会看到弓子会从鞋的长轴向下转。

sentences.en: That's the weak form of the knot. But not to worry.
sentences.zh: 这是结的弱点,但不用担心

sentences.en: If we start over and simply go the other direction around the bow, we get this, the strong form of the knot.
sentences.zh: 如果我们重新开始 沿着船首走另一条路 我们就会明白 结结的强烈形式

sentences.en: And if you pull the cords under the knot, you will see that the bow orients itself along the transverse axis of the shoe.
sentences.zh: 如果你把绳子拉在绳子下 你就会看到弓子 沿着鞋的横轴旋转

sentences.en: This is a stronger knot. It will come untied less often.
sentences.zh: 结得更结实 解开的次数会少一些

sentences.en: It will let you down less, and not only that, it looks better.
sentences.zh: 它会让你少失望, 不仅如此,它看起来更好。

sentences.en: We're going to do this one more time. (Applause) Start as usual -- (Applause) go the other way around the loop.
sentences.zh: 我们再做一次。 开始像往常一样—— (掌声) 绕到另一圈去。

sentences.en: This is a little hard for children, but I think you can handle it.
sentences.zh: 这对孩子们来说有点困难 但我想你能应付

sentences.en: Pull the knot. There it is: the strong form of the shoe knot.
sentences.zh: 拉绳结,就是那个 鞋结的坚固形式

sentences.en: Now, in keeping with today's theme, I'd like to point out -- something you already know -- that sometimes a small advantage someplace in life can yield tremendous results someplace else.
sentences.zh: 现在,为了与今天的主题保持一致,我想指出——一些你已经知道的事情—— 有时候在生活中某个地方的一个小优势 可以在别的地方产生巨大的结果。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Live long and prosper. (Applause)
sentences.zh: (笑) 长寿和繁荣。 (鼓掌)
